dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Could you tell me about Merusea Village?

dialogues.speaker: Serene
dialogues.text: This is the home of us Melusines, but... as you can see, owing to the location, we don't get many human visitors.

dialogues.speaker: Serene
dialogues.text: Be sure to let me know if you run into any trouble here, or if you need anything at all.
